 Juwai Teer Results Chart 2024
 Juwai Teer results for 2024 are arranged here as a month-by-month chart of the Jowai draws: Juwai Teer, Juwai Morning Teer and Juwai Night Teer. Reading down a month's table gives each day's first and second round numbers in order, which makes the Juwai teer chart the quickest way to find an old result, confirm a number someone has quoted, or look at the houses and endings that appeared over several weeks.
 Juwai Teer Result Chart 2024: the first round (FR) and second round (SR) results of Juwai Teer, Juwai Morning Teer and Juwai Night Teer from September 2024 to December 2024, one table per month.
 Use Select Year to open the chart of another year, Select Teer Type to show one game only and Select Month to jump to that month's table.
 Scheduled times: Juwai Teer FR at 2:00 PM and SR at 2:40 PM; Juwai Morning Teer FR at 10:30 AM and SR at 11:30 AM; Juwai Night Teer FR at 9:30 PM and SR at 10:30 PM.
 A round shown as XX has not been declared yet, and OFF means no result was published for that round.

 Juwai Teer Result Chart FAQs
 What is the Juwai Teer result chart? 
 It lists the Juwai teer results month by month: the date, the teer type and its first round (FR) and second round (SR) number. The 2024 chart has results from September 2024 to December 2024. 
 Which teer types are in the Juwai Teer chart? 
 The chart has 3 teer types: Juwai Teer (FR 2:00 PM, SR 2:40 PM); Juwai Morning Teer (FR 10:30 AM, SR 11:30 AM); Juwai Night Teer (FR 9:30 PM, SR 10:30 PM). 
 How do I find a past Juwai teer result in the chart? 
 Pick the year in Select Year and the month in Select Month; the page scrolls to that month's table. Select Teer Type narrows every month to one game. 
 For which years is the Juwai Teer chart available? 
 Charts are available for every year from 2023 to 2026. The current year's chart covers the last 12 months and updates as results are declared. 
 What do XX and OFF mean in the chart? 
 XX means that round has no declared result: still to come on the day's draw, or never published for an older date. OFF means no result was published for that round. 
 Where can I see today's Juwai teer results? 
 On the Juwai Teer results page, which shows today's FR and SR as soon as they are declared, with the last 30 days of each game.
